answer: The protocol mandates staking collateral C per validator and applies quadratic slashing S = α·(C·k)² for any Sybil cluster of size k, turning marginal attack cost into a super-linear function of locked capital. Because penalty grows with k², an attacker faces negative expected attack utility even when coordinating a haven of colluding nodes. A zero-knowledge verifiable delay locks commitments, and economic security threshold defined by ocean of staked value exceeds the knoll of extractable gain, guaranteeing a robust Nash equilibrium for honest participation.
